description: Answer key for the jazzy_hiphop fixture: what's a good rec for THIS listener, with the subtleties that separate taste-inference from genre-echoing.
annotated_by: wyatt (seed 2026-07-14; reviewed with engine author 2026-10-03 — fixture restored to 6 reviews, golden realigned)
notes: Schema: entries go in good/bad as before. Optional fields per entry: 'tier' = 'expected' (in-lane) or 'novel' (an original move — adjacent scene/cross-genre bridge; must still be an artist the model plausibly knows); 'pair' = a contrast-pair name shared by one good-side and one bad-side entry that are near-identical except for the subtlety the listener splits on; 'reason' = WHY, citing the taste pattern the fixture reviews imply. RULE: every entry must be inferable from the fixture's reviews — the fixture is the exam, this file is the answer key. Pair scoring: +1 if the engine recs the good side only, 0 if neither, -1 if it recs the bad side (even alongside the good side). Novel scoring: how many novel good entries got hit (the 'originality' signal). 2026-10-03 session: jh-1/jh-4/jh-6 restored (Dilla 4★, Skyzoo 4★, Cosmogramma 2★); Madlib/Tomppabeats out; Kamasi downgraded to tag-only (user: 'okay fit, not great — it's just jazz'); The Roots + Kendrick added from user grading of real v1.1 recs.
